app.name: WASAC water billing
error.offline: No connection. Check your mobile data or Wi-Fi, then try again.
error.timeout: This is taking too long. Check your mobile data, then try again.
error.server: Our system could not do this just now. Try again in a few minutes.
error.notFound: We could not find your account. Contact WASAC customer care.
error.invalid: Something in this request was not accepted. Check it and try again.
language.label: Language
nav.label: Main
camera.title: Read your meter
camera.unavailable.title: The camera is not available
camera.unavailable.body: Allow camera access in your browser settings, or upload a photo of your meter.
camera.photoKept: Your photo is saved, so you don't need to take it again.
camera.saved: You have a photo that was not sent yet. Send it, or take a new one.
camera.notImage: That file is not a photo. Choose a photo of your meter.
camera.unreadable.title: We could not read the numbers in this photo
camera.unreadable.body: Wipe the meter glass, make sure there is light, and take the photo closer to the numbers.
camera.locationOff: Location is off, so an officer will check this reading before your bill. Turn on location to skip that.
camera.liveOff: Live tips are off to save mobile data.
camera.liveEnded: Live tips have stopped. Take the photo when the numbers are inside the box.
camera.cropAlt: The meter numbers, cut from your photo
guidance.noMeter: We couldn't find a water meter. Point the camera at the meter's number window.
guidance.tooFar: Try moving a little closer to the meter.
guidance.cutOff: Some numbers may be cut off. Try moving back a little.
guidance.tooDark: It looks dark. Try turning on a light or using your phone's torch.
guidance.glare: There may be a reflection. Try tilting the phone slightly.
guidance.hardToRead: The numbers are hard to see. If the glass is dirty or wet, wipe it gently and try again.
guidance.aim: Point the camera at the meter's numbers and hold still.
confirm.title: Check the numbers
confirm.question: Do these numbers match your meter?
confirm.tapHint: Tap a number to change it.
confirm.manual: Type all 8 numbers on your meter: the 5 on black, then the 3 on red.
confirm.needsCheck: We read {raw}. Check the numbers on your meter and type them here.
confirm.needsCheckEmpty: Check the numbers on your meter and type them here.
confirm.incomplete: Fill in all 8 numbers. If a wheel shows nothing, type 0.
confirm.retakeBody: We could not use this reading. Take the photo again, close to the numbers and with good light.
confirm.notNow: This reading can't be sent now: your last reading is still being checked, or this month's reading is already in. Home shows when you can send the next one.
held.title: Reading sent
held.checkingBody: A WASAC officer is checking this reading. When they finish, the result will appear in Messages. You don't need to do anything.
bill.title: {month} bill
bill.howNote: The more water you use in a month, the higher the price for each extra cubic metre. The service charge is the same every month.
pay.title: Pay with Mobile Money
pay.from: You pay from the MTN Mobile Money number on your account: {phone}.
pay.unsure: We could not confirm the payment. Check your bills before you try again, so you don't pay twice.
history.title: Your bills
history.empty: No bills yet. Take your first meter photo.
history.checking: Your first bill will appear here once a WASAC officer has checked your reading.
home.readPrompt: Read your meter to get your next bill.
home.checkingBody: A WASAC officer is checking the reading you sent. The result will appear in Messages. You don't need to do anything.
home.readingInBody: Thank you. You can send your next reading from {date}.
gate.pendingBody: A WASAC officer is checking the reading you sent. You can send a new one after the decision; we'll tell you in Messages.
home.highUse: We noticed higher water use than usual. Read the message to see what to check.
messages.title: Messages
messages.empty: No messages. We'll tell you here if we notice anything unusual about your water use.
msg.SPIKE.title: Much more water than usual
msg.SPIKE.noticed: On {date}, your meter showed much more water than your home usually uses.
msg.SUSTAINED_HIGH.title: High water use for a while
msg.SUSTAINED_HIGH.noticed: Your water use has been higher than usual for several readings, up to {date}.
msg.MISREAD_SUSPECTED.title: A reading lower than the last one
msg.MISREAD_SUSPECTED.noticed: The reading you sent on {date} is lower than your last one. Meters only count up, so we check readings like this.
msg.METER_STUCK.title: Your meter may not be moving
msg.METER_STUCK.noticed: Your meter has shown the same reading for a while, up to {date}. If you use water and the numbers don't change, contact WASAC customer care.
msg.UNUSUAL.title: An unusual reading
msg.UNUSUAL.noticed: The reading you sent on {date} looks different from your usual water use.
msg.LOCATION_CHECK.title: We're checking where the photo was taken
msg.LOCATION_CHECK.first_location: The photo you sent on {date} is the first one from your meter. An officer checks it once and saves where your meter is, so later readings go straight through.
msg.LOCATION_CHECK.far: The photo you sent on {date} was taken far from where your meter is on our records, so an officer will check it before your bill.
msg.LOCATION_CHECK.no_location: Your phone did not share its location when you sent the photo on {date}, so an officer will check the reading before your bill.
msg.LOCATION_CHECK.imprecise: Your phone's location was not precise enough when you sent the photo on {date}, so an officer will check the reading before your bill.
msg.LOCATION_CHECK.upload: The photo you sent on {date} was chosen from your gallery, not taken with the camera, so an officer will check it before your bill.
msg.leak.check3: wet ground or walls near your pipes
msg.leak.cost: Leaking water goes through your meter and is on your bill, so fix a leak as soon as you can.
msg.status.open: A WASAC officer is checking this reading. You don't need to do anything.
msg.status.accepted: Checked and confirmed. Your bill is ready.
msg.status.rejected: We could not confirm this reading. Please read your meter again.
landing.title: Read your water meter in a minute.
landing.lede: Take a photo of your meter, check the numbers, and pay your bill with MTN Mobile Money.
landing.step1: Take a photo of the numbers on your meter.
landing.step2: Check the numbers we read and correct any that are wrong.
landing.step3: See your bill and pay it with MTN Mobile Money.
error.unauthorized: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
error.locked: Too many wrong attempts. Wait 5 minutes, then try again.
error.conflict: Someone has already dealt with this. Refresh to see the latest.
error.tooMany: Too many tries in a short time. Wait a minute, then try again.
error.tooLarge: This photo is too large. Take a new photo, or choose a smaller one.
error.forbidden: Your account cannot do this. Ask an admin if you need it.
demo.label: Demo data
signin.title: Staff sign-in
signin.lede: For WASAC billing and field staff. Review held readings and follow up on households.
signin.wrong: That username and password do not match. Check them and try again.
signin.help: Forgot your password? Ask an admin to reset it.
signin.household.title: Sign in
signin.household.lede: Use the phone number registered with WASAC. We'll send you a code by SMS. No password needed.
signin.household.badPhone: Enter a Rwandan mobile number, for example 078 123 4567.
signin.household.tooMany: Too many tries. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
signin.household.codeLede: If {phone} is registered with WASAC, we have sent a 6-digit code to it by SMS. It works for 10 minutes.
signin.household.wrongCode: That code is not right, or it has expired. Check it, or ask for a new code.
signin.household.demoBody: No SMS is sent for demo accounts. Your code is
signin.household.chooseLede: This phone number has more than one meter. Choose the one you want to see.
staff.sms.lede: Messages sent through the SMS sandbox, newest first. The sandbox does not reach real phones, so read sign-in codes and notices here.
staff.sms.none: No SMS sent through the sandbox yet.
staff.roleCan.officer: Checks held readings and sees households.
staff.roleCan.supervisor: As an officer, and sees everyone's activity.
staff.roleCan.admin: As a supervisor, and manages staff accounts.
staff.activity.ledeOwn: Your sign-ins and decisions, newest first.
staff.activity.ledeAll: Every sign-in, decision and account change, newest first.
staff.accounts.lede: Add people, set what they can do, and reset forgotten passwords.
staff.accounts.name: Full name
staff.accounts.usernameHint: 3 to 32 lowercase letters or digits; dots and dashes allowed. Example: a.mukamana
staff.accounts.roleHelp: Officers check readings. Supervisors also see everyone's activity. Admins also manage accounts.
staff.accounts.badInput: Enter the full name and a username of 3 to 32 lowercase letters or digits.
staff.accounts.taken: That username is taken. Choose another.
staff.accounts.resetConfirm: Give {name} a new temporary password? Their current password stops working.
staff.accounts.issuedHelp: It is shown only now. Give it to the person directly (not by email), and ask them to change it under My account.
staff.password.title: Change your password
staff.password.hint: At least {count} characters. A short sentence is easy to remember.
staff.password.mismatch: The two new passwords are not the same.
staff.password.wrongCurrent: Your current password is not right.
staff.password.changed: Password changed. Use it next time you sign in.
staff.households.search: Search by name, meter or sector
staff.review.lede: {count} readings are waiting. Check each one against the household's usual use.
staff.review.keys: Keys: J next, K previous, A accept, R reject, U undo.
staff.review.where.first_location: No location on file for this meter yet. Accepting saves where this photo was taken (phone accurate to {accuracy}).
staff.review.where.no_location: Unknown: the phone sent no location
staff.review.where.imprecise: Unclear: the phone was only accurate to {accuracy}
staff.review.where.upload: Chosen from the gallery, not taken with the camera
staff.review.noPhoto: The meter photo is not stored with readings yet.
staff.review.reject: Reject, ask for a new photo
staff.review.acceptNote: Accepting creates the bill. Rejecting asks the household, in Messages, to send a new photo.
staff.review.acceptedBill: Accepted the reading for {name}. Bill created: {amount}.
staff.review.rejected: Rejected the reading for {name}. They will be asked for a new photo.
staff.review.empty: No readings are waiting for a decision. New held readings appear here.
notFound.title: This page does not exist
notFound.body: Check the address, or go back to the start.
pwa.iosHint: On iPhone: tap Share, then “Add to Home Screen”.
